blocks.text:
Day 2 · Breakfast, then a private half-day city tour. Begin in the city centre at La Moneda, a historical monument in the traditional neoclassical style, built at the end of the Spanish colonial period to house the royal mint; since the mid-19th century it has been the seat of the Chilean government. Continue to the Plaza de Armas, the central square where the city’s history began, home to the Governor’s House, the Municipality of Santiago, the Main Post Office, the Royal Audiencia building and the Cathedral.

Climb San Cristóbal Hill to the statue of the Virgin Mary for a magnificent panorama of the whole city, then discover the modern districts of Vitacura, Las Condes and Providencia, drive along the Mapocho River and admire the architecture of Santiago’s main avenues. Return to the hotel.
